sentences.text:
Author: T. Rajani
Bench: T. Rajani
 Smt.Justice T.Rajani
 Criminal Petition No. 4665 of 2020
O R D E R:

This criminal petition is filed under Section 482 Cr.P.C. seeking to quash the proceedings in Crime No.207 of 2020 on the file of the Station House Officer, Tenali I Town Police Station, Guntur District, against the petitioner for the offence punishable under Sections 188, 420, 272, 273 IPC and Sections 7(1), 20(1), 22 of COTPA Act and Sections 56, 57(1) and 63 of Food Safety and Standards Act, 2006.

entities.text: Tenali I Town Police Station, Guntur District
entities.label: ORG

sentences.text: Heard learned counsel for the petitioner and learned Public Prosecutor appearing for respondent-State.
Learned counsel for the petitioner submits that the issue in this case is squarely covered by the order dated 21.07.2020 passed in Criminal Petition No.2408 of 2020 by this Court.
In view of the aforesaid, it is urged that the FIR may be quashed against the petitioners.

A perusal of the said order would show that this Court has taken into consideration of the common order dated 18.12.2019 passed by a coordinate Bench of this court in Crl.P.Nos.5421 of 2019 & Batch holding that "tobacco" does not fall within the definition of "food", as specified under Section 3(i)(j)
of the Act and that therefore, registration of FIR is not permissible.
Learned Public Prosecutor did not oppose the said submission.

Considering the submissions and in view of the fact that this matter is squarely covered by the earlier orders, the criminal petition is allowed and proceedings in Crime No.207 of 2020 on the file of the Station House Officer, Tenali I Town Police Station, Guntur District, against the petitioner for the offence punishable under Sections 188, 420, 272, 273 IPC and Sections 7(1), 20(1), 22 of COTPA Act and Sections 56, 57(1)
and 63 of Food Safety and Standards Act, 2006, are hereby quashed.
Miscellaneous applications pending if any, shall stand closed.
